scope: Current workspace UI and its shipped native controls on synthetic local fixtures. Classic layout restoration and short-window menus receive regression checks.
actualActionCoverage: character browse/profile/create/native edit and cast lifecycle
composer, native streaming/nonstreaming generation, Stop, partial replies and resume
images, writer, voice and dictation setup/failure/retry using synthetic providers
message actions/editing, CFG, logprobs and chat file panels
Data Bank search/sort/bulk controls, Token Counter, gallery open/close and file chooser entry points
populated lorebook editor and persona create/rename/delete dialogs
settings categories/sections/disclosures/provider choices and checkbox/radio branches
manualBrowserReview: initial portrait overlap reproduction and portrait correction
320px Quick Replies actions, World & lore, Account, nested Settings Snapshots at 320x400; screenshots under review/

workspace.remainingFailure: Fixture expected a new writer profile although native Connection Manager correctly reused a matching existing profile.
workspace.correction: Assert native reuse and preserve existing profiles; corrected case passed 3 repeats on the fixture containing the existing profile.

uiAudit.remainingFailure: Floating gallery Close lacked an explicit button role.
uiAudit.correction: Native template role, accessible name and keyboard owner; 3 Enter runs passed, then 2 final Enter/Space runs.

verification.resumeRegression: stream-reader-verified.log: 11 passed; deterministic delayed-start cases failed on both desktop and phone before the native stream fix.
verification.continuity: continuity.log: no structural errors; existing TESTING.md compactness warning retained

exceptions: Hidden Select2 native proxies are recorded but their visible replacement owns interaction. They are not scrolled for screenshots.
Overlapping dual-range input rails share a hit region; their center-point proxy is excluded from obstruction assertions.
Console/network diagnostics are retained, including unavailable-provider probes, intentional rejections and 404s; zero uncaught page errors is not a claim of zero failed HTTP requests.
limits: Not every possible combination of user content, settings, custom theme and third-party extension.
Provider forms and synthetic request/retry flows are qualified; paid/external service output is not.
Headless/emulated sizes and shared Chromium browser are not physical-device, microphone or audible-quality qualification.
Account/snapshot views were inspected; destructive account resets, real restores, external documentation links and third-party installation were not executed.
Production application/data/logs/volumes were not inspected. No release, commit or deployment was performed.
priorAttempts: Earlier failing/interrupted runs are retained as attempts. Do not treat their initial inventories or pass counts as the final acceptance record.

versionedLogCopies.normalization: ANSI color escapes and trailing whitespace removed; raw logs remain local and unchanged.
